originality.rationale: Exact half-line step cluster limits and their countably infinite topology follow from the spike-window calculation. Ji–Yang 2026 proves scalar connectedness under bounded-below hypotheses and notes existential disconnection otherwise; those stated results do not give this precise injective dense-range classification. Multiple exact-phrase, synonym, literature and mathematical-record searches returned no direct match. Risk remains from an incompletely accessible later example and unindexed older work, so this is best-knowledge originality only.

value.rationale: The construction sharpens a natural hypothesis for connectedness of asymptotic operator-root cluster sets: even injectivity, positive weights and dense range do not prevent countably infinitely many isolated WOT/SOT components. It classifies the whole cluster topology and exhibits a strict spectral-versus-asymptotic numerical radius gap, while all scalar numerical ranges remain intervals.
